```rust
            .collect(),
    }
}
```

```rust
fn convert_download_resposta(resposta: Resposta<DownloadItem>) -> RespostaJson {
    use base64::Engine as _;
    let engine = base64::engine::general_purpose::STANDARD;
    RespostaJson {
        id: resposta.id.to_string(),
        ok: resposta.ok,
        status: resposta.status as u32,
        mensagem: resposta.mensagem,
        dados: resposta.dados.into_iter()
            .map(|d| {
                serde_json::json!({
                    "filename": d.filename,
                    "buffer": engine.encode(&d.buffer),
                    "formato": d.formato,
                })
            })
            .collect(),
        erros: resposta.erros.into_iter()
            .map(|e| serde_json::to_value(e).unwrap_or(serde_json::Value::Null))
            .collect(),
    }
}
```

```rust
use open_mtr_core::*;
use std::sync::OnceLock;

static RUNTIME: OnceLock<tokio::runtime::Runtime> = OnceLock::new();

fn runtime() -> &'static tokio::runtime::Runtime {
    RUNTIME.get_or_init(|| {
        tokio::runtime::Runtime::new().expect("Failed to create runtime")
    })
}

#[derive(Debug, uniffi::Error, thiserror::Error)]
pub enum OpenMtrError {
    #[error("{0}")]
    Generic(String),
}

impl From<String> for OpenMtrError {
    fn from(s: String) -> Self {
        OpenMtrError::Generic(s)
    }
}

impl From<open_mtr_core::OpenMTRError> for OpenMtrError {
    fn from(e: open_mtr_core::OpenMTRError) -> Self {
        OpenMtrError::Generic(e.to_string())
    }
}

pub struct OpenMtrClient {
    inner: open_mtr_core::OpenMtrClient,
}

impl OpenMtrClient {
    pub fn init(system: String, token: String, base_url: Option<String>) -> Result<Self, OpenMtrError> {
        let mut builder = open_mtr_core::OpenMtrClient::builder();
        let system: System = system.parse().map_err(|e: String| OpenMtrError::Generic(e))?;
        builder = builder.base(system).token(token);
        if let Some(url) = base_url {
            builder = builder.base_url(url);
        }
        let client = runtime().block_on(builder.build())?;
        Ok(Self { inner: client })
    }

    pub fn listar_manifestos(&self, filtro_json: String) -> Result<String, OpenMtrError> {
        let filtro: FiltroMtr = serde_json::from_str(&filtro_json)
            .map_err(|e| OpenMtrError::Generic(e.to_string()))?;
        let resposta = runtime().block_on(self.inner.consultar_mtr(&filtro))?;
        serde_json::to_string(&resposta).map_err(|e| OpenMtrError::Generic(e.to_string()))
    }

    pub fn cancelar_manifesto(&self, numero: String, justificativa: String) -> Result<String, OpenMtrError> {
        let req = CancelarMtr { numero, justificativa };
        let resposta = runtime().block_on(self.inner.cancelar_mtrs(vec![req]))?;
        serde_json::to_string(&resposta).map_err(|e| OpenMtrError::Generic(e.to_string()))
    }

    pub fn download_pdf(&self, numero: String) -> Result<Vec<u8>, OpenMtrError> {
        let mut resposta = runtime().block_on(self.inner.download_mtrs(vec![numero]))?;
        let item = resposta.dados.pop()
            .ok_or_else(|| OpenMtrError::Generic("No download data returned".to_string()))?;
        Ok(item.buffer)
    }
}
```

```rust
use std::sync::OnceLock;

static RUNTIME: OnceLock<tokio::runtime::Runtime> = OnceLock::new();

fn runtime() -> &'static tokio::runtime::Runtime {
    RUNTIME.get_or_init(|| {
        tokio::runtime::Runtime::new().expect("Failed to create runtime")
    })
}

#[derive(Debug)]
pub enum OpenMtrError {
    Generic,
}
```

```rust
        match self {
            OpenMtrError::Generic => write!(f, "An error occurred"),
        }
    }

pub struct OpenMtrClient {
    inner: open_mtr_core::OpenMtrClient,
}

impl OpenMtrClient {
    pub fn init(system: String, token: String, base_url: Option<String>) -> Result<Self, OpenMtrError> {
        let system: System = system.parse().map_err(|_: String| OpenMtrError::Generic)?;
        let mut builder = open_mtr_core::OpenMtrClient::builder()
            .base(system)
            .token(token);
        if let Some(url) = base_url {
            builder = builder.base_url(url);
        }
        let client = runtime().block_on(builder.build())?;
        Ok(Self { inner: client })
    }

    pub fn listar_manifestos(&self, filtro_json: String) -> Result<String, OpenMtrError> {
        let filtro: FiltroMtr = serde_json::from_str(&filtro_json).map_err(|_: serde_json::Error| OpenMtrError::Generic)?;
        let resposta = runtime().block_on(self.inner.consultar_mtr(&filtro))?;
        serde_json::to_string(&resposta).map_err(|_: serde_json::Error| OpenMtrError::Generic)
    }

    pub fn cancelar_manifesto(&self, numero: String, justificativa: String) -> Result<String, OpenMtrError> {
        let req = CancelarMtr { numero, justificativa };
        let resposta = runtime().block_on(self.inner.cancelar_mtrs(vec![req]))?;
        serde_json::to_string(&resposta).map_err(|_: serde_json::Error| OpenMtrError::Generic)
    }

    pub fn download_pdf(&self, numero: String) -> Result<Vec<u8>, OpenMtrError> {
        let mut resposta = runtime().block_on(self.inner.download_mtrs(vec![numero]))?;
        let item = resposta.dados.pop().ok_or(OpenMtrError::Generic)?;
        Ok(item.buffer)
    }
}
```

```
9:     ResiduoCriacao, ResiduoIbama, ResiduoRecebido, StatusMtr, TipoParte, TratamentoResiduo,
10:     UnidadeMedida,
11: };
12: use crate::openmtr::error::OpenMTRError;
13: use crate::openmtr::resposta::Problema;
14: use crate::openmtr::system::System;

16: use crate::schemas::common::{DataMtr as OldDataMtr, ObjetoRespostaRest};
17: use crate::schemas::manifesto as old_man;
18: use crate::schemas::salvar_manifesto as old_salvar;
19: use crate::schemas::recebimento as old_recb;

22: // ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
23: // Helper: status string → domain StatusMtr
24: // ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
25: 
26: fn map_status_sinir(status: &str) -> StatusMtr {
27:     match status {
28:         "ATIVO" | "Ativo" => StatusMtr::Ativo,
29:         "EM_TRANSPORTE" | "Em Transporte" => StatusMtr::EmTransporte,
30:         "RECEBIDO" | "Recebido" => StatusMtr::Recebido,
31:         "CANCELADO" | "Cancelado" => StatusMtr::Cancelado,
32:         "EXPIRADO" | "Expirado" => StatusMtr::Expirado,
33:         other => StatusMtr::Outro(other.to_string()),
34:     }
35: }
36: 
37: // ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
38: // Helper: domain TipoParte → old TipoParceiro
39: // ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
40: 
41: fn tipo_parte_para_tipo_parceiro(tipo: &TipoParte) -> old_man::TipoParceiro {
42:     match tipo {
43:         TipoParte::Gerador => old_man::TipoParceiro::Gerador,
44:         TipoParte::Transportador => old_man::TipoParceiro::Transportador,
45:         TipoParte::Destinador => old_man::TipoParceiro::Destinador,
46:         TipoParte::Armazenador => old_man::TipoParceiro::Armazenador,
47:         TipoParte::Outro(_) => old_man::TipoParceiro::Gerador,
48:     }
49: }
50: 
51: // ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
52: // Helper: domain CpfCnpj → old schemas::cpf::CpfCnpj
53: // ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
54: 
55: fn doc_para_old_cpf_cnpj(doc: &crate::openmtr::domain::CpfCnpj) -> crate::schemas::cpf::CpfCnpj {
56:     crate::schemas::cpf::CpfCnpj::new(doc.as_str())
57:         .expect("documento já validado pelo domínio")
58: }
59: 
60: // ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
61: // Helper: FiltroMtr → ApiwsListaManifestoDTO
62: // ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
63: 
64: fn filtro_para_dto(filtro: &FiltroMtr) -> old_man::ApiwsListaManifestoDTO {
65:     let (data_inicial, data_final) = match &filtro.periodo {
66:         Some(range) => (
67:             OldDataMtr::new(range.start),
68:             OldDataMtr::new(range.end),
69:         ),
70:         None => {
71:             let hoje = chrono::Utc::now().date_naive();
72:             let mes_atras = hoje - chrono::Duration::days(30);
73:             (OldDataMtr::new(mes_atras), OldDataMtr::new(hoje))
74:         }
75:     };
76: 
77:     let tipo_parceiro = filtro
78:         .parte
79:         .as_ref()
80:         .map(|p| tipo_parte_para_tipo_parceiro(&p.tipo))
81:         .unwrap_or(old_man::TipoParceiro::Gerador);
82: 
83:     old_man::ApiwsListaManifestoDTO {
84:         data_inicial,
85:         data_final,
86:         tipo_parceiro,
87:         pagina: Some(filtro.pagina.unwrap_or(0) as i32),
88:         tamanho_pagina: Some(filtro.tamanho.unwrap_or(100) as i32),
89:     }
90: }
91: 
92: // ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
93: // Helper: old ParceiroMTR → domain Parte
94: // ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
95: 
96: fn parceiro_mtr_para_parte(old: old_man::ParceiroMTR) -> Parte {
97:     let documento = old.cnpj.map_or_else(
98:         || {
99:             crate::openmtr::domain::CpfCnpj::Cnpj(
100:                 crate::openmtr::domain::Cnpj::parse_unchecked("00000000000000"),
101:             )
102:         },
103:         |c| {
104:             crate::openmtr::domain::CpfCnpj::new(c.as_str())
105:                 .expect("CNPJ da resposta SINIR já validado")
106:         },
107:     );
108: 
109:     Parte {
110:         documento,
111:         razao_social: old.descricao,
112:         endereco: old.endereco,
113:         municipio: old.cidade,
114:         uf: old.uf,
115:         unidade: old.codigo.map(|c| c as u32),
116:     }
117: }
118: 
119: // ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
120: // Helper: ManifestoResumo → Mtr
121: // ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
122: 
123: fn manifesto_resumo_para_mtr(old: old_man::ManifestoResumo) -> Mtr {
124:     let data_criacao = old
125:         .man_data
126:         .and_then(|ts| chrono::DateTime::from_timestamp_millis(ts))
127:         .map(|dt| dt.date_naive());
128: 
129:     Mtr {
130:         numero: old.man_numero,
131:         status: map_status_sinir(&old.man_status.unwrap_or_default()),
132:         gerador: old.parceiro_gerador.map(parceiro_mtr_para_parte),
133:         transportador: old.parceiro_transportador.map(parceiro_mtr_para_parte),
134:         destinador: old.parceiro_destinador.map(parceiro_mtr_para_parte),
135:         residuos: Vec::new(),
136:         data_criacao,
137:         data_recebimento: None,
138:     }
139: }
140: 
141: // ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
142: // Helper: domain Parte → old ParteManifesto
143: // ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
144: 
145: fn parte_para_manifesto(parte: &Parte) -> old_salvar::ParteManifesto {
146:     old_salvar::ParteManifesto {
147:         cpf_cnpj: doc_para_old_cpf_cnpj(&parte.documento),
148:         unidade: parte.unidade.unwrap_or(0) as i32,
149:     }
150: }

152: // ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
153: // Helper: domain ResiduoCriacao → old ResiduoManifestoRequest
154: // ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
155: 
156: fn residuo_criacao_para_dto(r: ResiduoCriacao) -> old_salvar::ResiduoManifestoRequest {
157:     old_salvar::ResiduoManifestoRequest {
158:         res_codigo_ibama: r.codigo_ibama,
159:         quantidade: r.quantidade,
160:         uni_codigo: r.unidade as i32,
161:         tie_codigo: r.estado_fisico as i32,
162:         cla_codigo: r.classe as i32,
163:         tia_codigo: r.acondicionamento as i32,
164:         tra_codigo: r.tratamento as i32,
165:         descricao_interna: r.descricao_interna,
166:         codigo_interno: r.codigo_interno,
167:     }
168: }

170: // ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
171: // Helper: CriarMtr → SalvarManifestoLoteRequest
172: // ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
173: 
174: fn criar_mtr_para_dto(criar: CriarMtr) -> old_salvar::SalvarManifestoLoteRequest {
175:     old_salvar::SalvarManifestoLoteRequest {
176:         possui_armazenamento_temporario: criar.armazenador_temporario.is_some(),
177:         nome_responsavel: criar.responsavel,
178:         gerador: parte_para_manifesto(&criar.gerador),
179:         transportador: parte_para_manifesto(&criar.transportador),
180:         destinador: parte_para_manifesto(&criar.destinador),
181:         armazenador_temporario: criar.armazenador_temporario.as_ref().map(parte_para_manifesto),
182:         nome_motorista: criar.motorista,
183:         placa_veiculo: criar.placa_veiculo,
184:         data_expedicao: criar.data_expedicao.map(|dt| dt.and_utc().timestamp_millis()),
185:         observacoes: criar.observacoes,
186:         tipo_manifesto: criar.tipo_manifesto.map(|t| t.codigo()),
187:         sim_codigo: None,
188:         lista_residuos: criar.residuos.into_iter().map(residuo_criacao_para_dto).collect(),
189:     }
190: }
191: 
192: // ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
193: // Helper: domain ResiduoRecebido → old ResiduoRecebido
194: // ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
195: 
196: fn residuo_recebido_para_dto(r: &ResiduoRecebido) -> old_recb::ResiduoRecebido {
197:     old_recb::ResiduoRecebido {
198:         res_codigo_ibama: r.codigo_ibama.clone(),
199:         quantidade_recebida: r.quantidade_recebida,
200:         uni_codigo: r.unidade as i32,
201:         tie_codigo: r.estado_fisico.map(|v| v as i32),
202:         cla_codigo: r.classe.map(|v| v as i32),
203:         tia_codigo: r.acondicionamento.map(|v| v as i32),
204:         tra_codigo: r.tratamento.map(|v| v as i32),
205:         sequencial: None,
206:     }
207: }
208: 
209: // ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
210: // Helper: ReceberMtr → ApiwsManifestoDeRecebimentoDTO
211: // ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
212: 
213: fn receber_mtr_para_dto(receber: ReceberMtr) -> old_recb::ApiwsManifestoDeRecebimentoDTO {
214:     let residuos = if receber.residuos_recebidos.is_empty() {
215:         None
216:     } else {
217:         Some(
218:             receber
219:                 .residuos_recebidos
220:                 .iter()
221:                 .map(residuo_recebido_para_dto)
222:                 .collect(),
223:         )
224:     };
225: 
226:     old_recb::ApiwsManifestoDeRecebimentoDTO {
227:         man_numero: receber.numero,
228:         data_recebimento: crate::schemas::recebimento::TimestampMs(
229:             receber.data_recebimento.and_utc().timestamp_millis(),
230:         ),
231:         nome_responsavel: receber.responsavel,
232:         observacoes: receber.observacoes,
233:         lista_residuos_recebidos: residuos,
234:     }
235: }

285: // ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
286: // SinirAdapter
287: // ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
288: 
289: pub(crate) struct SinirAdapter;
290: 
291: #[async_trait]
292: impl MtrAdapter for SinirAdapter {
293:     fn system(&self) -> System {
294:         System::Sinir
295:     }
296: 
297:     fn nome(&self) -> &'static str {
298:         "SINIR Nacional"
299:     }
300: 
301:     async fn autenticar_token(&self, ctx: &MtrCtx) -> Result<String, OpenMTRError> {
302:         let span = info_span!("sinir.autenticar_token");
303:         let _guard = span.enter();
304:         let refresh_url = format!("{}/token", ctx.config.base_url);
305:         drop(_guard);
306:         ctx.http.set_refresh_url(&refresh_url).await;
307:         let token = ctx.http.get_token().await?;
308:         info!("Token SINIR renovado com sucesso");
309:         Ok(token)
310:     }
311: 
312:     async fn autenticar_credenciais(
313:         &self,
314:         _ctx: &MtrCtx,
315:         _cpf: &str,
316:         _senha: &str,
317:         _unidade: u32,
318:     ) -> Result<String, OpenMTRError> {
319:         Err(OpenMTRError::not_supported(
320:             "SINIR usa integration_token, não CPF/senha",
321:         ))
322:     }
323: 
324:     // -----------------------------------------------------------------------
325:     // consultar_mtrs
326:     // -----------------------------------------------------------------------
327: 
328:     async fn consultar_mtrs(
329:         &self,
330:         ctx: &MtrCtx,
331:         filtro: &FiltroMtr,
332:     ) -> Result<Vec<Mtr>, OpenMTRError> {
333:         let _span = info_span!("sinir.consultar_mtrs");
334: 
335:         let dto = filtro_para_dto(filtro);
336:         let response: ObjetoRespostaRest<Vec<old_man::ManifestoResumo>> =
337:             ctx.http.post("/listaManifesto", &dto, "consultar_mtrs").await?;
338: 
339:         if response.erro {
340:             warn!(
341:                 mensagem = ?response.mensagem,
342:                 "SINIR retornou erro em consultar_mtrs"
343:             );
344:             return Ok(Vec::new());
345:         }
346: 
347:         let items = response.objeto_resposta.unwrap_or_default();
348:         let mtrs: Vec<Mtr> = items.into_iter().map(manifesto_resumo_para_mtr).collect();
349: 
350:         info!(total = %mtrs.len(), "MTRs consultados");
351:         Ok(mtrs)
352:     }
353: 
354:     // -----------------------------------------------------------------------
355:     // criar_mtrs
356:     // -----------------------------------------------------------------------
357: 
358:     async fn criar_mtrs(
359:         &self,
360:         ctx: &MtrCtx,
361:         mtrs: Vec<CriarMtr>,
362:     ) -> Result<LoteResult<MtrCriado>, OpenMTRError> {
363:         let _span = info_span!("sinir.criar_mtrs");
364: 
365:         let mut itens = Vec::with_capacity(mtrs.len());
366: 
367:         for (indice, criar) in mtrs.into_iter().enumerate() {
368:             let dto = criar_mtr_para_dto(criar);
369:             match ctx
370:                 .http
371:                 .post::<old_salvar::SalvarManifestoResponse, _>(
372:                     "/salvarManifestoLote",
373:                     &dto,
374:                     "criar_mtr",
375:                 )
376:                 .await
377:             {
378:                 Ok(resp) => {
379:                     if resp.erro_nacional {
380:                         let msg = resp
381:                             .mensagem_erro
382:                             .unwrap_or_else(|| "Erro nacional na criação".into());
383:                         itens.push(ItemResult::Erro {
384:                             indice,
385:                             problema: Problema::validation(msg),
386:                         });
387:                         continue;
388:                     }
389: 
390:                     let some_respostas = resp.respostas.unwrap_or_default();
391:                     if some_respostas.is_empty() {
392:                         itens.push(ItemResult::Erro {
393:                             indice,
394:                             problema: Problema::validation(
395:                                 "Nenhuma resposta retornada pela API",
396:                             ),
397:                         });
398:                         continue;
399:                     }
400: 
401:                     for r in some_respostas {
402:                         if r.valido {
403:                             itens.push(ItemResult::Ok(MtrCriado {
404:                                 numero: r.manifesto_numero,
405:                                 codigo_gerado: r.codigo_gerado,
406:                                 sucesso: true,
407:                                 mensagem: r.mensagem,
408:                             }));
409:                         } else {
410:                             itens.push(ItemResult::Erro {
411:                                 indice,
412:                                 problema: Problema::validation(r.mensagem),
413:                             });
414:                         }
415:                     }
416:                 }
417:                 Err(e) => {
418:                     warn!(erro = %e, "Falha ao criar MTR");
419:                     itens.push(ItemResult::Erro {
420:                         indice,
421:                         problema: Problema::api(502, e.to_string()),
422:                     });
423:                 }
424:             }
425:         }
426: 
427:         info!(total = %itens.len(), "MTRs criados");
428:         Ok(LoteResult::new(itens))
429:     }
430: 
431:     // -----------------------------------------------------------------------
432:     // receber_mtrs
433:     // -----------------------------------------------------------------------
434: 
435:     async fn receber_mtrs(
436:         &self,
437:         ctx: &MtrCtx,
438:         lotes: Vec<ReceberMtr>,
439:     ) -> Result<LoteResult<MtrRecebido>, OpenMTRError> {
440:         let _span = info_span!("sinir.receber_mtrs");
441: 
442:         let mut itens = Vec::with_capacity(lotes.len());
443: 
444:         for (indice, receber) in lotes.into_iter().enumerate() {
445:             let dto = receber_mtr_para_dto(receber);
446:             match ctx
447:                 .http
448:                 .post::<old_recb::RecebimentoLoteResponse, _>(
449:                     "/receberManifestoLote",
450:                     &dto,
451:                     "receber_mtr",
452:                 )
453:                 .await
454:             {
455:                 Ok(resp) => {
456:                     let some_items = resp.objeto.unwrap_or_default();
457:                     if some_items.is_empty() {
458:                         itens.push(ItemResult::Erro {
459:                             indice,
460:                             problema: Problema::validation("Nenhum retorno no recebimento"),
461:                         });
462:                         continue;
463:                     }
464: 
465:                     for item in some_items {
466:                         if item.recebido {
467:                             itens.push(ItemResult::Ok(MtrRecebido {
468:                                 numero: item.man_numero,
469:                                 recebido: true,
470:                                 mensagem: Some(item.mensagem),
471:                             }));
472:                         } else {
473:                             itens.push(ItemResult::Erro {
474:                                 indice,
475:                                 problema: Problema::validation(item.mensagem),
476:                             });
477:                         }
478:                     }
479:                 }
480:                 Err(e) => {
481:                     warn!(erro = %e, "Falha ao receber MTR");
482:                     itens.push(ItemResult::Erro {
483:                         indice,
484:                         problema: Problema::api(502, e.to_string()),
485:                     });
486:                 }
487:             }
488:         }
489: 
490:         info!(total = %itens.len(), "MTRs recebidos");
491:         Ok(LoteResult::new(itens))
492:     }
493: 
494:     // -----------------------------------------------------------------------
495:     // cancelar_mtrs
496:     // -----------------------------------------------------------------------
497: 
498:     async fn cancelar_mtrs(
499:         &self,
500:         ctx: &MtrCtx,
501:         reqs: Vec<CancelarMtr>,
502:     ) -> Result<LoteResult<MtrCancelado>, OpenMTRError> {
503:         let _span = info_span!("sinir.cancelar_mtrs");
504: 
505:         let mut itens = Vec::with_capacity(reqs.len());
506: 
507:         for (indice, req) in reqs.into_iter().enumerate() {
508:             let dto = old_man::CancelaManifestoDTO::new(&req.numero, &req.justificativa);
509:             match ctx
510:                 .http
511:                 .post::<ObjetoRespostaRest<old_man::CancelamentoResponse>, _>(
512:                     "/cancelarManifesto",
513:                     &dto,
514:                     "cancelar_mtr",
515:                 )
516:                 .await
517:             {
518:                 Ok(resp) => {
519:                     if resp.erro {
520:                         let msg = resp.mensagem.unwrap_or_else(|| "Erro no cancelamento".into());
521:                         itens.push(ItemResult::Erro {
522:                             indice,
523:                             problema: Problema::validation(msg),
524:                         });
525:                         continue;
526:                     }
527: 
528:                     match resp.objeto_resposta {
529:                         Some(cancel) => {
530:                             let status = cancel.status.to_lowercase();
531:                             if status == "cancelado" {
532:                                 itens.push(ItemResult::Ok(MtrCancelado {
533:                                     numero: cancel.man_numero,
534:                                     status: cancel.status,
535:                                     data_cancelamento: Some(cancel.data_cancelamento),
536:                                 }));
537:                             } else {
538:                                 itens.push(ItemResult::Erro {
539:                                     indice,
540:                                     problema: Problema::api(
541:                                         400,
542:                                         format!("Status inesperado: {}", cancel.status),
543:                                     ),
544:                                 });
545:                             }
546:                         }
547:                         None => {
548:                             itens.push(ItemResult::Erro {
549:                                 indice,
550:                                 problema: Problema::validation("Resposta vazia no cancelamento"),
551:                             });
552:                         }
553:                     }
554:                 }
555:                 Err(e) => {
556:                     warn!(erro = %e, "Falha ao cancelar MTR");
557:                     itens.push(ItemResult::Erro {
558:                         indice,
559:                         problema: Problema::api(502, e.to_string()),
560:                     });
561:                 }
562:             }
563:         }
564: 
565:         info!(total = %itens.len(), "MTRs cancelados");
566:         Ok(LoteResult::new(itens))
567:     }
568: 
569:     // -----------------------------------------------------------------------
570:     // modificar_mtrs (apenas solicitar_alteracao / recebimento)
571:     // -----------------------------------------------------------------------
572: 
573:     async fn modificar_mtrs(
574:         &self,
575:         ctx: &MtrCtx,
576:         reqs: Vec<ModificarMtr>,
577:     ) -> Result<LoteResult<MtrModificado>, OpenMTRError> {
578:         let _span = info_span!("sinir.modificar_mtrs");
579: 
580:         let mut itens = Vec::with_capacity(reqs.len());
581: 
582:         for (indice, req) in reqs.into_iter().enumerate() {
583:             match req.tipo {
584:                 ModificacaoTipo::Recebimento => {
585:                     let justificativa =
586:                         req.justificativa.unwrap_or_else(|| "Alteração de recebimento".into());
587:                     let novos = req.novos_residuos.unwrap_or_default();
588: 
589:                     let dto = old_recb::ApiwsAlteraRecebimentoDTO {
590:                         man_numero: req.numero,
591:                         justificativa,
592:                         lista_residuos_alterados: novos
593:                             .iter()
594:                             .map(|r| old_recb::ResiduoAlterado {
595:                                 res_codigo_ibama: r.codigo_ibama.clone(),
596:                                 nova_quantidade: r.quantidade_recebida,
597:                                 uni_codigo: r.unidade as i32,
598:                                 observacoes: None,
599:                             })
600:                             .collect(),
601:                     };
602: 
603:                     match ctx
604:                         .http
605:                         .post::<serde_json::Value, _>("/alteraRecebimento", &dto, "modificar_mtr")
606:                         .await
607:                     {
608:                         Ok(_json) => {
609:                             itens.push(ItemResult::Ok(MtrModificado {
610:                                 numero: dto.man_numero,
611:                                 modificado: true,

613:                             }));

617:                             itens.push(ItemResult::Erro {
618:                                 indice,
619:                                 problema: Problema::api(502, e.to_string()),
620:                             });
621:                         }
622:                     }
623:                 }
624:                 _ => {

626:                         indice,

628:                             "Tipo de modificação não suportado no SINIR: {:?}",
629:                             req.tipo

631:                     });
632:                 }
633:             }
634:         }

637:         Ok(LoteResult::new(itens))

694:                     .unwrap_or(0),
695:                 nome_responsavel: req.responsavel,

699:             match ctx
700:                 .http
701:                 .post::<old_cdf::CDFEmissaoResponse, _>("/emiteCDF", &dto, "gerar_cdf")
702:                 .await

710:                         itens.push(ItemResult::Ok(CdfEmitido {

712:                             numero: objeto.cdf_numero,

715:                         }));

721:                         });
722:                     }
723:                 },
724:                 Err(e) => {

729:                     });
730:                 }
731:             }
732:         }
733: 
734:         info!(total = %itens.len(), "CDFs emitidos");
735:         Ok(LoteResult::new(itens))
736:     }
```

```
326:     pub async fn get_token(&self) -> Result<String, OpenMTRError> {
327:         let guard = self.token_mgr.read().await;
328:         if let Some(t) = guard.token() {
329:             return Ok(t.to_string());
330:         }
331:         drop(guard);
332:         let mut guard = self.token_mgr.write().await;
333:         guard.refresh(&self.http).await?;
334:         guard
335:             .token()
336:             .ok_or_else(|| OpenMTRError::auth("No token available after refresh"))
337:             .map(|t| t.to_string())
338:     }
339: }

341: fn map_http_error(status: StatusCode, detail: &str) -> OpenMTRError {
342:     match status.as_u16() {
343:         401 => OpenMTRError::auth(format!("Unauthorized: {detail}")),
344:         403 => OpenMTRError::new(403, "Forbidden", detail),
345:         404 => OpenMTRError::new(404, "Not Found", detail),
346:         422 => OpenMTRError::validation(detail),
347:         429 => OpenMTRError::new(429, "Too Many Requests", detail),
348:         s if s >= 500 => OpenMTRError::new(s, "Server Error", detail),
349:         _ => OpenMTRError::new(status.as_u16(), "HTTP Error", detail),
350:     }
351: }
```

```
8:     let engine = base64::engine::general_purpose::STANDARD;
9:     RespostaJson {
10:         id: resposta.id.to_string(),
11:         ok: resposta.ok,
12:         status: resposta.status as u32,
13:         mensagem: resposta.mensagem,
14:         dados: resposta
15:             .dados
16:             .into_iter()
17:             .map(|d| serde_json::to_value(d).unwrap_or(serde_json::Value::Null))
18:             .collect(),
19:         erros: resposta
20:             .erros
21:             .into_iter()
22:             .map(|e| serde_json::to_value(e).unwrap_or(serde_json::Value::Null))
23:             .collect(),
24:     }
25: }
26: 
27: fn convert_download_resposta(resposta: Resposta<DownloadItem>) -> RespostaJson {
28:     let engine = base64::engine::general_purpose::STANDARD;
29:     RespostaJson {
30:         id: resposta.id.to_string(),
31:         ok: resposta.ok,
32:         status: resposta.status as u32,
33:         mensagem: resposta.mensagem,
34:         dados: resposta
35:             .dados
36:             .into_iter()
37:             .map(|d| {
38:                 serde_json::json!({
39:                     "filename": d.filename,
40:                     "buffer": engine.encode(&d.buffer),
41:                     "formato": d.formato,
42:                 })
43:             })
44:             .collect(),
45:         erros: resposta
46:             .erros
47:             .into_iter()
48:             .map(|e| serde_json::to_value(e).unwrap_or(serde_json::Value::Null))
49:             .collect(),
50:     }
51: }

53: fn map_err(e: OpenMTRError) -> napi::Error {
54:     napi::Error::from_reason(e.to_string())
55: }

59:     pub id: String,

68: pub struct OpenMtrClient {
69:     inner: tokio::sync::OnceCell<open_mtr_core::OpenMtrClient>,
70:     system: String,

72:     base_url: Option<String>,
73: }
74: 
75: #[napi]
76: impl OpenMtrClient {
77:     #[napi(constructor)]
78:     pub fn new(system: String, token: String, base_url: Option<String>) -> Self {
79:         Self {
80:             inner: tokio::sync::OnceCell::new(),
81:             system,
82:             token,
83:             base_url,
84:         }
85:     }
86: 
87:     async fn get_client(&self) -> Result<&open_mtr_core::OpenMtrClient> {
88:         let system = self.system.clone();
89:         let token = self.token.clone();
90:         let base_url = self.base_url.clone();
91:         self.inner
92:             .get_or_try_init(async move {
93:                 let parsed: open_mtr_core::System = system
94:                     .parse()
95:                     .map_err(|e: String| napi::Error::from_reason(e))?;
96:                 let mut builder =
97:                     open_mtr_core::OpenMtrClient::builder().base(parsed).token(token);
98:                 if let Some(url) = base_url {
99:                     builder = builder.base_url(url);
100:                 }
101:                 builder.build().await.map_err(|e| napi::Error::from_reason(e.to_string()))
102:             })
103:             .await
104:             .map_err(|e| e)
105:     }
106: 
107:     #[napi]
108:     pub async fn consultar_mtr(&self, filtro_json: String) -> Result<RespostaJson> {
109:         let client = self.get_client().await?;
110:         let filtro: FiltroMtr = serde_json::from_str(&filtro_json)
111:             .map_err(|e| napi::Error::from_reason(e.to_string()))?;
112:         let resposta = client.consultar_mtr(&filtro).await.map_err(map_err)?;
113:         Ok(convert_resposta(resposta))
114:     }
115:

117:     pub async fn cancelar_mtrs(&self, cancelamentos_json: String) -> Result<RespostaJson> {
118:         let client = self.get_client().await?;

120:             .map_err(|e| napi::Error::from_reason(e.to_string()))?;
121:         let resposta = client.cancelar_mtrs(reqs).await.map_err(map_err)?;
122:         Ok(convert_resposta(resposta))
123:     }

127:         let client = self.get_client().await?;
128:         let resposta = client.download_mtrs(nums).await.map_err(map_err)?;
129:         Ok(convert_download_resposta(resposta))
```

```
19: pub type MtrResult<T> = Result<Resposta<T>, OpenMTRError>;

21: pub struct OpenMtrClient {

40: impl OpenMtrClient {
41:     async fn exec<T>(&self, op: &str, future: impl std::future::Future<Output = Result<Vec<T>, OpenMTRError>>) -> MtrResult<T> {
42:         let id = Uuid::now_v7();
43:         let _span = info_span!("openmtr", operation = %op, instance = %id, system = %self.ctx.config.system.nome()).entered();
44: 
45:         match future.await {
46:             Ok(dados) => {
47:                 let len = dados.len();
48:                 info!(ok = true, total = len, "Operação concluída");
49:                 Ok(Resposta::com_mensagem(id, dados, "OK"))
50:             }
51:             Err(e) => {
52:                 error!(ok = false, error = %e.detail, "Operação falhou");
53:                 Err(e)
54:             }
55:         }

57: 
58:     async fn exec_lote<T>(&self, op: &str, future: impl std::future::Future<Output = Result<LoteResult<T>, OpenMTRError>>) -> MtrResult<T> {
59:         let id = Uuid::now_v7();
60:         let _span = info_span!("openmtr", operation = %op, instance = %id, system = %self.ctx.config.system.nome());
61: 
62:         match future.await {
63:             Ok(lote) => {
64:                 let erros: Vec<Problema> = lote.erros().into_iter().cloned().collect();
65:                 let dados: Vec<T> = lote.itens.into_iter().filter_map(|item| match item {
66:                     ItemResult::Ok(val) => Some(val),
67:                     ItemResult::Erro { .. } => None,
68:                 }).collect();
69:                 let len = dados.len();
70:                 info!(ok = true, total = len, "Operação concluída");
71:                 if erros.is_empty() {
72:                     Ok(Resposta::com_mensagem(id, dados, "OK"))
73:                 } else {
74:                     Ok(Resposta { id, ok: true, status: 200, mensagem: "OK".into(), dados, erros })
75:                 }
76:             }
77:             Err(e) => {
78:                 error!(ok = false, error = %e.detail, "Operação falhou");
79:                 Err(e)
80:             }
81:         }
82:     }
83:

146: pub struct OpenMtrClientBuilder {
147:     system: Option<System>,
148:     base_url: Option<String>,
149:     integration_token: Option<String>,
150:     timeout: Option<Duration>,
151:     max_rps: Option<u32>,
152: }
153: 
154: impl OpenMtrClientBuilder {
155:     pub fn base(mut self, system: System) -> Self {
156:         self.system = Some(system);
157:         self
158:     }
159: 
160:     pub fn base_url(mut self, url: impl Into<String>) -> Self {
161:         self.base_url = Some(url.into());
162:         self
163:     }
164: 
165:     pub fn token(mut self, token: impl Into<String>) -> Self {
166:         self.integration_token = Some(token.into());
167:         self
168:     }
169: 
170:     pub fn timeout_secs(mut self, secs: u64) -> Self {
171:         self.timeout = Some(Duration::from_secs(secs));
172:         self
173:     }
174: 
175:     pub fn max_rps(mut self, rps: u32) -> Self {
176:         self.max_rps = Some(rps);
177:         self
178:     }
179: 
180:     pub async fn build(self) -> Result<OpenMtrClient, OpenMTRError> {
181:         let system = self.system.ok_or_else(|| {
182:             OpenMTRError::config("system é obrigatório — use .base(System::...)")
183:         })?;
184: 
185:         let integration_token = self.integration_token.ok_or_else(|| {
186:             OpenMTRError::config("integration_token é obrigatório — use .token(...)")
187:         })?;
188: 
189:         let base_url = self
190:             .base_url
191:             .unwrap_or_else(|| system.default_base_url().to_string());
192: 
193:         let config = Config::builder()
194:             .system(system)
195:             .base_url(base_url)
196:             .token(integration_token.clone())
197:             .timeout_secs(self.timeout.map(|d| d.as_secs()).unwrap_or(60))
198:             .max_rps(self.max_rps.unwrap_or(10))
199:             .build()?;
200: 
201:         let http = MtrHttpClient::new(config.clone())?;
202: 
203:         let adapter = system.adapter();
204: 
205:         let ctx = MtrCtx { http, config };
206: 
207:         adapter.autenticar_token(&ctx).await?;
208: 
209:         info!(
210:             system = %adapter.nome(),
211:             "openMTR client initialized"
212:         );
213: 
214:         Ok(OpenMtrClient {
215:             ctx: Arc::new(ctx),
216:             adapter,
217:         })
218:     }
219: }
```

### Task 2: uniffi/src/lib.rs

The new API for uniffi needs to:
1. Use `open_mtr_core::*`
2. Use synchronous wrappers with tokio runtime
3. Expose: `init`, `listar_manifestos`, `cancelar_manifesto`, `download_pdf`

```rust
uniffi::setup_scaffolding!();

use open_mtr_core::*;
use tokio::runtime::Runtime;
use std::sync::OnceLock;

static RUNTIME: OnceLock<Runtime> = OnceLock::new();

fn runtime() -> &'static Runtime {
    RUNTIME.get_or_init(|| Runtime::new().expect("Failed to create runtime"))
}

pub struct OpenMtrClient {
    inner: open_mtr_core::OpenMtrClient,
}

impl OpenMtrClient {
    pub fn init(system: String, token: String, base_url: Option<String>) -> Result<Self, String> {
        let system: open_mtr_core::System = system.parse().map_err(|e: String| e)?;
        let mut builder = open_mtr_core::OpenMtrClient::builder()
            .base(system)
            .token(token);
        if let Some(url) = base_url {
            builder = builder.base_url(url);
        }
        let client = runtime().block_on(builder.build()).map_err(|e| e.to_string())?;
        Ok(Self { inner: client })
    }

    pub fn listar_manifestos(&self, filtro_json: String) -> Result<String, String> {
        let filtro: FiltroMtr = serde_json::from_str(&filtro_json).map_err(|e| e.to_string())?;
        let resposta = runtime()
            .block_on(self.inner.consultar_mtr(&filtro))
            .map_err(|e| e.to_string())?;
        serde_json::to_string(&resposta).map_err(|e| e.to_string())
    }

    pub fn cancelar_manifesto(&self, numero: String, justificativa: String) -> Result<String, String> {
        let req = CancelarMtr { numero, justificativa };
        let mut resposta = runtime()
            .block_on(self.inner.cancelar_mtrs(vec![req]))
            .map_err(|e| e.to_string())?;
        // Return the first (only) result as JSON string
        serde_json::to_string(&resposta).map_err(|e| e.to_string())
    }

    pub fn download_pdf(&self, numero: String) -> Result<Vec<u8>, String> {
        let mut resposta = runtime()
            .block_on(self.inner.download_mtrs(vec![numero]))
            .map_err(|e| e.to_string())?;
        // Take the first result's buffer
        resposta.dados.pop()
            .map(|item| item.buffer)
            .ok_or_else(|| "Nenhum arquivo encontrado".to_string())
    }
}
```

Wait, the task says `download_pdf` returns `Vec<u8>` - which is just the buffer. But `download_mtrs` returns `Resposta<DownloadItem>`, where `DownloadItem` has `buffer: Vec<u8>`, `filename: String`, `formato: String`. So `download_pdf` should extract just the buffer.

```rust
uniffi::setup_scaffolding!();

use open_mtr_core::*;
use tokio::runtime::Runtime;
use std::sync::OnceLock;

static RUNTIME: OnceLock<Runtime> = OnceLock::new();

fn runtime() -> &'static Runtime {
    RUNTIME.get_or_init(|| Runtime::new().expect("Failed to create runtime"))
}

#[derive(Debug, uniffi::Error, thiserror::Error)]
pub enum OpenMtrError {
    #[error("{0}")]
    General(String),
}

pub struct OpenMtrClient {
    inner: open_mtr_core::OpenMtrClient,
}

impl OpenMtrClient {
    pub fn init(system: String, token: String, base_url: Option<String>) -> Result<Self, OpenMtrError> {
        let system: open_mtr_core::System = system.parse().map_err(|e: String| OpenMtrError::General(e))?;
        let mut builder = open_mtr_core::OpenMtrClient::builder()
            .base(system)
            .token(token);
        if let Some(url) = base_url {
            builder = builder.base_url(url);
        }
        let client = runtime().block_on(builder.build()).map_err(|e| OpenMtrError::General(e.to_string()))?;
        Ok(Self { inner: client })
    }

    pub fn listar_manifestos(&self, filtro_json: String) -> Result<String, OpenMtrError> {
        let filtro: FiltroMtr = serde_json::from_str(&filtro_json).map_err(|e| OpenMtrError::General(e.to_string()))?;
        let resposta = runtime()
            .block_on(self.inner.consultar_mtr(&filtro))
            .map_err(|e| OpenMtrError::General(e.to_string()))?;
        serde_json::to_string(&resposta).map_err(|e| OpenMtrError::General(e.to_string()))
    }

    pub fn cancelar_manifesto(&self, numero: String, justificativa: String) -> Result<String, OpenMtrError> {
        let req = CancelarMtr { numero, justificativa };
        let resposta = runtime()
            .block_on(self.inner.cancelar_mtrs(vec![req]))
            .map_err(|e| OpenMtrError::General(e.to_string()))?;
        serde_json::to_string(&resposta).map_err(|e| OpenMtrError::General(e.to_string()))
    }

    pub fn download_pdf(&self, numero: String) -> Result<Vec<u8>, OpenMtrError> {
        let mut resposta = runtime()
            .block_on(self.inner.download_mtrs(vec![numero]))
            .map_err(|e| OpenMtrError::General(e.to_string()))?;
        resposta.dados.pop()
            .map(|item| item.buffer)
            .ok_or_else(|| OpenMtrError::General("Nenhum arquivo encontrado".to_string()))
    }
}
```

```rust
uniffi::setup_scaffolding!();

use open_mtr_core::*;
use std::sync::OnceLock;
use tokio::runtime::Runtime;

static RUNTIME: OnceLock<Runtime> = OnceLock::new();

fn runtime() -> &'static Runtime {
    RUNTIME.get_or_init(|| Runtime::new().expect("Failed to create tokio runtime"))
}

fn map_error(e: OpenMTRError) -> OpenMtrError {
    let url = e.r#type.as_str();
    if url.contains("network") {
        OpenMtrError::Network
    } else if url.contains("timeout") {
        OpenMtrError::Timeout
    } else if url.contains("authentication") || url.contains("auth") {
        OpenMtrError::Auth
    } else if url.contains("configuration") || url.contains("config") {
        OpenMtrError::Config
    } else if url.contains("validation") {
        OpenMtrError::Validation
    } else {
        OpenMtrError::Api
    }
}

#[derive(Debug, uniffi::Error)]
pub enum OpenMtrError {
    Api,
    Network,
    Timeout,
    Auth,
    Config,
    Validation,
}

impl std::fmt::Display for OpenMtrError {
    fn fmt(&self, f: &mut std::fmt::Formatter<'_>) -> std::fmt::Result {
        match self {
            Self::Api => write!(f, "Erro de API"),
            Self::Network => write!(f, "Erro de rede"),
            Self::Timeout => write!(f, "Tempo limite excedido"),
            Self::Auth => write!(f, "Erro de autenticação"),
            Self::Config => write!(f, "Erro de configuração"),
            Self::Validation => write!(f, "Erro de validação"),
        }
    }
}

impl std::error::Error for OpenMtrError {}

pub struct OpenMtrClient {
    inner: open_mtr_core::OpenMtrClient,
}

impl OpenMtrClient {
    pub fn init(system: String, token: String, base_url: Option<String>) -> Result<Self, OpenMtrError> {
        let sys: open_mtr_core::System = system.parse().map_err(|_| OpenMtrError::Config)?;
        let mut builder = open_mtr_core::OpenMtrClient::builder().base(sys).token(token);
        if let Some(url) = base_url {
            builder = builder.base_url(url);
        }
        let client = runtime().block_on(builder.build()).map_err(map_error)?;
        Ok(Self { inner: client })
    }

    pub fn listar_manifestos(&self, filtro_json: String) -> Result<String, OpenMtrError> {
        let filtro: FiltroMtr = serde_json::from_str(&filtro_json).map_err(|_| OpenMtrError::Validation)?;
        let resposta = runtime()
            .block_on(self.inner.consultar_mtr(&filtro))
            .map_err(map_error)?;
        serde_json::to_string(&resposta).map_err(|_| OpenMtrError::Api)
    }

    pub fn cancelar_manifesto(&self, numero: String, justificativa: String) -> Result<String, OpenMtrError> {
        let req = CancelarMtr { numero, justificativa };
        let resposta = runtime()
            .block_on(self.inner.cancelar_mtrs(vec![req]))
            .map_err(map_error)?;
        serde_json::to_string(&resposta).map_err(|_| OpenMtrError::Api)
    }

    pub fn download_pdf(&self, numero: String) -> Result<Vec<u8>, OpenMtrError> {
        let mut resposta = runtime()
            .block_on(self.inner.download_mtrs(vec![numero]))
            .map_err(map_error)?;
        resposta.dados.pop()
            .map(|item| item.buffer)
            .ok_or(OpenMtrError::Api)
    }
}
```

### `uniffi/src/lib.rs` — updated

```rust
uniffi::setup_scaffolding!();

use open_mtr_core::*;
use std::sync::OnceLock;
use tokio::runtime::Runtime;

static RUNTIME: OnceLock<Runtime> = OnceLock::new();

fn runtime() -> &'static Runtime {
    RUNTIME.get_or_init(|| Runtime::new().expect("Failed to create tokio runtime"))
}

fn map_error(e: OpenMTRError) -> OpenMtrError {
    let url = e.r#type.as_str();
    if url.contains("network") {
        OpenMtrError::Network
    } else if url.contains("timeout") {
        OpenMtrError::Timeout
    } else if url.contains("authentication") || url.contains("auth") {
        OpenMtrError::Auth
    } else if url.contains("configuration") || url.contains("config") {
        OpenMtrError::Config
    } else if url.contains("validation") {
        OpenMtrError::Validation
    } else {
        OpenMtrError::Api
    }
}

#[derive(Debug, uniffi::Error)]
pub enum OpenMtrError {
    Api,
    Network,
    Timeout,
    Auth,
    Config,
    Validation,
}

impl std::fmt::Display for OpenMtrError {
    fn fmt(&self, f: &mut std::fmt::Formatter<'_>) -> std::fmt::Result {
        match self {
            Self::Api => write!(f, "Erro de API"),
            Self::Network => write!(f, "Erro de rede"),
            Self::Timeout => write!(f, "Tempo limite excedido"),
            Self::Auth => write!(f, "Erro de autenticação"),
            Self::Config => write!(f, "Erro de configuração"),
            Self::Validation => write!(f, "Erro de validação"),
        }
    }
}

impl std::error::Error for OpenMtrError {}

pub struct OpenMtrClient {
    inner: open_mtr_core::OpenMtrClient,
}

impl OpenMtrClient {
    pub fn init(
        system: String,
        token: String,
        base_url: Option<String>,
    ) -> Result<Self, OpenMtrError> {
        let sys: open_mtr_core::System =
            system.parse().map_err(|_: String| OpenMtrError::Config)?;
        let mut builder = open_mtr_core::OpenMtrClient::builder().base(sys).token(token);
        if let Some(url) = base_url {
            builder = builder.base_url(url);
        }
        let client = runtime()
            .block_on(builder.build())
            .map_err(map_error)?;
        Ok(Self { inner: client })
    }

    pub fn listar_manifestos(&self, filtro_json: String) -> Result<String, OpenMtrError> {
        let filtro: FiltroMtr =
            serde_json::from_str(&filtro_json).map_err(|_| OpenMtrError::Validation)?;
        let resposta = runtime()
            .block_on(self.inner.consultar_mtr(&filtro))
            .map_err(map_error)?;
        serde_json::to_string(&resposta).map_err(|_| OpenMtrError::Api)
    }

    pub fn cancelar_manifesto(
        &self,
        numero: String,
        justificativa: String,
    ) -> Result<String, OpenMtrError> {
        let req = CancelarMtr {
            numero,
            justificativa,
        };
        let resposta = runtime()
            .block_on(self.inner.cancelar_mtrs(vec![req]))
            .map_err(map_error)?;
        serde_json::to_string(&resposta).map_err(|_| OpenMtrError::Api)
    }

    pub fn download_pdf(&self, numero: String) -> Result<Vec<u8>, OpenMtrError> {
        let mut resposta = runtime()
            .block_on(self.inner.download_mtrs(vec![numero]))
            .map_err(map_error)?;
        resposta
            .dados
            .pop()
            .map(|item| item.buffer)
            .ok_or(OpenMtrError::Api)
    }
}
```

```
227:         codigo: v.get("traCodigo").and_then(|n| n.as_i64()).unwrap_or(0) as u32,
228:         descricao: v.get("traDescricao").and_then(|s| s.as_str()).unwrap_or_default().to_string(),
229:     }
230: }
231: 
232: fn json_para_residuo_ibama(v: &Value) -> ResiduoIbama {
233:     ResiduoIbama {
234:         codigo_ibama: v.get("resCodigoIbama").and_then(|s| s.as_str()).unwrap_or_default().to_string(),
235:         descricao: v.get("resDescricao").and_then(|s| s.as_str()).unwrap_or_default().to_string(),
236:     }
237: }
238: 
239: fn json_para_cdf_emitido(v: &Value) -> CdfEmitido {
240:     let data_emissao = v.get("dataEmissao")
241:         .and_then(|s| s.as_str())
242:         .and_then(|s| chrono::NaiveDate::parse_from_str(s, "%d/%m/%Y").ok())
243:         .unwrap_or_else(|| chrono::Utc::now().date_naive());
244: 
245:     CdfEmitido {
246:         codigo: v.get("cdfCodigo").and_then(|n| n.as_i64()).map(|n| n.to_string()).unwrap_or_default(),
247:         numero: v.get("cdfNumero").and_then(|s| s.as_str()).unwrap_or_default().to_string(),
248:         data_emissao,
249:         status: v.get("status").and_then(|s| s.as_str()).unwrap_or_default().to_string(),
250:     }
251: }
252: 
253: fn extrair_objeto_resposta(v: &Value) -> Option<&Value> {
254:     v.get("objetoResposta")
255: }
256: 
257: fn tem_erro(v: &Value) -> bool {
258:     v.get("erro").and_then(|b| b.as_bool()).unwrap_or(false)
259: }
260: 
261: pub(crate) struct SinirAdapter;
262: 
263: #[async_trait]
264: impl MtrAdapter for SinirAdapter {
265:     fn system(&self) -> System {
266:         System::Sinir
267:     }
268: 
269:     fn nome(&self) -> &'static str {
270:         "SINIR Nacional"
271:     }
272: 
273:     async fn autenticar_token(&self, ctx: &MtrCtx) -> Result<String, OpenMTRError> {
274:         let span = info_span!("sinir.autenticar_token");
275:         let _guard = span.enter();
276:         let refresh_url = format!("{}/token", ctx.config.base_url);
277:         drop(_guard);
278:         ctx.http.set_refresh_url(&refresh_url).await;
279:         let token = ctx.http.get_token().await?;
280:         info!("Token SINIR renovado com sucesso");
281:         Ok(token)
282:     }
283: 
284:     async fn autenticar_credenciais(
285:         &self,
286:         _ctx: &MtrCtx,
287:         _cpf: &str,
288:         _senha: &str,
289:         _unidade: u32,
290:     ) -> Result<String, OpenMTRError> {
291:         Err(OpenMTRError::not_supported(
292:             "SINIR usa integration_token, não CPF/senha",
293:         ))
294:     }
295: 
296:     async fn consultar_mtrs(
297:         &self,
298:         ctx: &MtrCtx,
299:         filtro: &FiltroMtr,
300:     ) -> Result<Vec<Mtr>, OpenMTRError> {
301:         let _span = info_span!("sinir.consultar_mtrs");
302: 
303:         let body = filtro_para_json(filtro);
304:         let response: Value = ctx.http.post("/listaManifesto", &body, "consultar_mtrs").await?;
305: 
306:         if tem_erro(&response) {
307:             warn!(
308:                 mensagem = ?response.get("mensagem"),
309:                 "SINIR retornou erro em consultar_mtrs"
310:             );
311:             return Ok(Vec::new());
312:         }
313: 
314:         let items = response.get("objetoResposta").and_then(|a| a.as_array()).cloned().unwrap_or_default();
315:         let mtrs: Vec<Mtr> = items.iter().map(json_para_mtr).collect();
316: 
317:         info!(total = %mtrs.len(), "MTRs consultados");
318:         Ok(mtrs)
319:     }
320: 
321:     async fn criar_mtrs(
322:         &self,
323:         ctx: &MtrCtx,
324:         mtrs: Vec<CriarMtr>,
325:     ) -> Result<LoteResult<MtrCriado>, OpenMTRError> {
326:         let _span = info_span!("sinir.criar_mtrs");
327: 
328:         let mut itens = Vec::with_capacity(mtrs.len());
329: 
330:         for (indice, criar) in mtrs.into_iter().enumerate() {
331:             let body = criar_mtr_para_json(&criar);
332:             match ctx
333:                 .http
334:                 .post::<Value, _>("/salvarManifestoLote", &body, "criar_mtr")
335:                 .await
336:             {
337:                 Ok(resp) => {
338:                     let erro_nacional = resp.get("erroNacional").and_then(|b| b.as_bool()).unwrap_or(false);
339:                     if erro_nacional {
340:                         let msg = resp
341:                             .get("mensagemErroNacional")
342:                             .and_then(|s| s.as_str())
343:                             .unwrap_or("Erro nacional na criação");
344:                         itens.push(ItemResult::Erro {
345:                             indice,
346:                             problema: Problema::validation(msg),
347:                         });
348:                         continue;
349:                     }
350: 
351:                     let some_respostas = resp.get("respostaApiwsManifestoDTO")
352:                         .and_then(|a| a.as_array())
353:                         .cloned()
354:                         .unwrap_or_default();
355: 
356:                     if some_respostas.is_empty() {
357:                         itens.push(ItemResult::Erro {
358:                             indice,
359:                             problema: Problema::validation(
360:                                 "Nenhuma resposta retornada pela API",
361:                             ),
362:                         });
363:                         continue;
364:                     }
365: 
366:                     for r in &some_respostas {
367:                         let criado = json_para_mtr_criado(r);
368:                         if criado.sucesso {
369:                             itens.push(ItemResult::Ok(criado));
370:                         } else {
371:                             itens.push(ItemResult::Erro {
372:                                 indice,
373:                                 problema: Problema::validation(criado.mensagem),
374:                             });
375:                         }
376:                     }
377:                 }
378:                 Err(e) => {
379:                     warn!(erro = %e, "Falha ao criar MTR");
380:                     itens.push(ItemResult::Erro {
381:                         indice,
382:                         problema: Problema::api(502, e.to_string()),
383:                     });
384:                 }
385:             }
386:         }
387: 
388:         info!(total = %itens.len(), "MTRs criados");
389:         Ok(LoteResult::new(itens))
390:     }
391: 
392:     async fn receber_mtrs(
393:         &self,
394:         ctx: &MtrCtx,
395:         lotes: Vec<ReceberMtr>,
396:     ) -> Result<LoteResult<MtrRecebido>, OpenMTRError> {
397:         let _span = info_span!("sinir.receber_mtrs");
398: 
399:         let mut itens = Vec::with_capacity(lotes.len());
400: 
401:         for (indice, receber) in lotes.into_iter().enumerate() {
402:             let body = receber_mtr_para_json(&receber);
403:             match ctx
404:                 .http
405:                 .post::<Value, _>("/receberManifestoLote", &body, "receber_mtr")
406:                 .await
407:             {
408:                 Ok(resp) => {
409:                     let some_items = resp.get("objeto")
410:                         .and_then(|a| a.as_array())
411:                         .cloned()
412:                         .unwrap_or_default();
413: 
414:                     if some_items.is_empty() {
415:                         itens.push(ItemResult::Erro {
416:                             indice,
417:                             problema: Problema::validation("Nenhum retorno no recebimento"),
418:                         });
419:                         continue;
420:                     }
421: 
422:                     for item in &some_items {
423:                         let recebido = json_para_mtr_recebido(item);
424:                         if recebido.recebido {
425:                             itens.push(ItemResult::Ok(recebido));
426:                         } else {
427:                             itens.push(ItemResult::Erro {
428:                                 indice,
429:                                 problema: Problema::validation(
430:                                     recebido.mensagem.unwrap_or_default(),
431:                                 ),
432:                             });
433:                         }
434:                     }
435:                 }
436:                 Err(e) => {
437:                     warn!(erro = %e, "Falha ao receber MTR");
438:                     itens.push(ItemResult::Erro {
439:                         indice,
440:                         problema: Problema::api(502, e.to_string()),
441:                     });
442:                 }
443:             }
444:         }
445: 
446:         info!(total = %itens.len(), "MTRs recebidos");
447:         Ok(LoteResult::new(itens))
448:     }

450:     async fn cancelar_mtrs(
451:         &self,
452:         ctx: &MtrCtx,
453:         reqs: Vec<CancelarMtr>,
454:     ) -> Result<LoteResult<MtrCancelado>, OpenMTRError> {
455:         let _span = info_span!("sinir.cancelar_mtrs");
456: 
457:         let mut itens = Vec::with_capacity(reqs.len());
458: 
459:         for (indice, req) in reqs.into_iter().enumerate() {
460:             let body = json!({ "manNumero": req.numero, "justificativa": req.justificativa });
461:             match ctx
462:                 .http
463:                 .post::<Value, _>("/cancelarManifesto", &body, "cancelar_mtr")
464:                 .await
465:             {
466:                 Ok(resp) => {
467:                     if tem_erro(&resp) {
468:                         let msg = resp.get("mensagem")
469:                             .and_then(|s| s.as_str())
470:                             .unwrap_or("Erro no cancelamento");
471:                         itens.push(ItemResult::Erro {
472:                             indice,
473:                             problema: Problema::validation(msg),
474:                         });
475:                         continue;
476:                     }
477: 
478:                     match extrair_objeto_resposta(&resp) {
479:                         Some(cancel) => {
480:                             let status_str = cancel.get("status")
481:                                 .and_then(|s| s.as_str())
482:                                 .unwrap_or_default()
483:                                 .to_lowercase();
484:                             if status_str == "cancelado" {
485:                                 itens.push(ItemResult::Ok(MtrCancelado {
486:                                     numero: cancel.get("manNumero")
487:                                         .and_then(|s| s.as_str())
488:                                         .unwrap_or_default()
489:                                         .to_string(),
490:                                     status: cancel.get("status")
491:                                         .and_then(|s| s.as_str())
492:                                         .unwrap_or_default()
493:                                         .to_string(),
494:                                     data_cancelamento: cancel.get("dataCancelamento")
495:                                         .and_then(|s| s.as_str())
496:                                         .map(String::from),
497:                                 }));
498:                             } else {
499:                                 let stat = cancel.get("status")
500:                                     .and_then(|s| s.as_str())
501:                                     .unwrap_or("unknown");
502:                                 itens.push(ItemResult::Erro {
503:                                     indice,
504:                                     problema: Problema::api(
505:                                         400,
506:                                         format!("Status inesperado: {stat}"),
507:                                     ),
508:                                 });
509:                             }
510:                         }
511:                         None => {
512:                             itens.push(ItemResult::Erro {
513:                                 indice,
514:                                 problema: Problema::validation("Resposta vazia no cancelamento"),
515:                             });
516:                         }
517:                     }
518:                 }
519:                 Err(e) => {
520:                     warn!(erro = %e, "Falha ao cancelar MTR");
521:                     itens.push(ItemResult::Erro {
522:                         indice,
523:                         problema: Problema::api(502, e.to_string()),
524:                     });
525:                 }
526:             }
527:         }
528: 
529:         info!(total = %itens.len(), "MTRs cancelados");
530:         Ok(LoteResult::new(itens))
531:     }
532: 
533:     async fn modificar_mtrs(
534:         &self,
535:         ctx: &MtrCtx,
536:         reqs: Vec<ModificarMtr>,
537:     ) -> Result<LoteResult<MtrModificado>, OpenMTRError> {
538:         let _span = info_span!("sinir.modificar_mtrs");
539: 
540:         let mut itens = Vec::with_capacity(reqs.len());
541: 
542:         for (indice, req) in reqs.into_iter().enumerate() {
543:             match req.tipo {
544:                 ModificacaoTipo::Recebimento => {
545:                     let justificativa =
546:                         req.justificativa.unwrap_or_else(|| "Alteração de recebimento".into());
547:                     let novos = req.novos_residuos.unwrap_or_default();
548: 
549:                     let body = json!({
550:                         "manNumero": req.numero,
551:                         "justificativa": justificativa,
552:                         "listaResiduosAlterados": novos.iter().map(|r| json!({
553:                             "resCodigoIbama": r.codigo_ibama,
554:                             "novaQuantidade": r.quantidade_recebida,
555:                             "uniCodigo": r.unidade,
556:                             "observacoes": Option::<String>::None,
557:                         })).collect::<Vec<_>>(),
558:                     });
559: 
560:                     match ctx
561:                         .http
562:                         .post::<Value, _>("/alteraRecebimento", &body, "modificar_mtr")
563:                         .await
564:                     {
565:                         Ok(_json) => {
566:                             itens.push(ItemResult::Ok(MtrModificado {
567:                                 numero: req.numero,
568:                                 modificado: true,
569:                                 mensagem: "Solicitação de alteração enviada".into(),
570:                             }));
571:                         }
572:                         Err(e) => {
573:                             warn!(erro = %e, "Falha ao modificar MTR");
574:                             itens.push(ItemResult::Erro {
575:                                 indice,
576:                                 problema: Problema::api(502, e.to_string()),
577:                             });
578:                         }
579:                     }
580:                 }
581:                 _ => {
582:                     itens.push(ItemResult::Erro {
583:                         indice,
584:                         problema: Problema::validation(format!(
585:                             "Tipo de modificação não suportado no SINIR: {:?}",
586:                             req.tipo
587:                         )),
588:                     });
589:                 }
590:             }
591:         }
592: 
593:         info!(total = %itens.len(), "MTRs modificados");
594:         Ok(LoteResult::new(itens))
595:     }

621:         }

714:                     warn!(codigo = %req.codigo, erro = %e, "Falha ao baixar CDF");
```

```
1: uniffi::setup_scaffolding!();

3: use open_mtr_core::*;
4: use std::sync::OnceLock;
5: use tokio::runtime::Runtime;
6: 
7: static RUNTIME: OnceLock<Runtime> = OnceLock::new();
8: 
9: fn runtime() -> &'static Runtime {
10:     RUNTIME.get_or_init(|| Runtime::new().expect("Failed to create tokio runtime"))
11: }
12: 
13: fn map_error(e: OpenMTRError) -> OpenMtrError {
14:     let url = e.r#type.as_str();
15:     if url.contains("network") {
16:         OpenMtrError::Network
17:     } else if url.contains("timeout") {
18:         OpenMtrError::Timeout
19:     } else if url.contains("authentication") || url.contains("auth") {
20:         OpenMtrError::Auth
21:     } else if url.contains("configuration") || url.contains("config") {
22:         OpenMtrError::Config
23:     } else if url.contains("validation") {
24:         OpenMtrError::Validation
25:     } else {
26:         OpenMtrError::Api
27:     }
28: }
29: 
30: #[derive(Debug, uniffi::Error)]
31: pub enum OpenMtrError {
32:     Api,
33:     Network,
34:     Timeout,
35:     Auth,
36:     Config,
37:     Validation,
38: }
39: 
40: impl std::fmt::Display for OpenMtrError {
41:     fn fmt(&self, f: &mut std::fmt::Formatter<'_>) -> std::fmt::Result {
42:         match self {
43:             Self::Api => write!(f, "Erro de API"),
44:             Self::Network => write!(f, "Erro de rede"),
45:             Self::Timeout => write!(f, "Tempo limite excedido"),
46:             Self::Auth => write!(f, "Erro de autenticação"),
47:             Self::Config => write!(f, "Erro de configuração"),
48:             Self::Validation => write!(f, "Erro de validação"),
49:         }
50:     }
51: }

53: impl std::error::Error for OpenMtrError {}
```

```
78:         endereco: v.get("parEndereco").and_then(|s| s.as_str()).map(String::from),

80:         uf: v.get("parUf").and_then(|s| s.as_str()).map(String::from),
81:         unidade: v.get("parCodigo").and_then(|n| n.as_i64()).map(|n| n as u32),
82:     }
83: }

85: fn json_para_mtr(v: &Value) -> Mtr {
86:     let data_criacao = v
87:         .get("manData")
88:         .and_then(|ts| ts.as_i64())
89:         .and_then(|ts| chrono::DateTime::from_timestamp_millis(ts))
90:         .map(|dt| dt.date_naive());
91: 
92:     Mtr {
93:         numero: v.get("manNumero").and_then(|s| s.as_str()).unwrap_or_default().to_string(),
94:         status: map_status_sinir(v.get("manStatus").and_then(|s| s.as_str()).unwrap_or_default()),
95:         gerador: v.get("parceiroGerador").map(json_para_parte),
96:         transportador: v.get("parceiroTransportador").map(json_para_parte),
97:         destinador: v.get("parceiroDestinador").map(json_para_parte),
98:         residuos: Vec::new(),
99:         data_criacao,
100:         data_recebimento: None,
101:     }
102: }

108:         "uniCodigo": r.unidade,
109:         "tieCodigo": r.estado_fisico,
110:         "claCodigo": r.classe,
111:         "tiaCodigo": r.acondicionamento,
112:         "traCodigo": r.tratamento,
113:         "marDescricaoInterna": r.descricao_interna,
114:         "marCodigoInterno": r.codigo_interno,

118: fn criar_mtr_para_json(criar: &CriarMtr) -> Value {
119:     json!({
120:         "possuiArmazenamentoTemporario": criar.armazenador_temporario.is_some(),
121:         "nomeResponsavel": criar.responsavel,
122:         "gerador": {
123:             "cpfCnpj": criar.gerador.documento.as_str(),
124:             "unidade": criar.gerador.unidade.unwrap_or(0),
125:         },
126:         "transportador": {
127:             "cpfCnpj": criar.transportador.documento.as_str(),
128:             "unidade": criar.transportador.unidade.unwrap_or(0),
129:         },
130:         "destinador": {
131:             "cpfCnpj": criar.destinador.documento.as_str(),
132:             "unidade": criar.destinador.unidade.unwrap_or(0),
133:         },
134:         "armazenadorTemporario": criar.armazenador_temporario.as_ref().map(|p| json!({
135:             "cpfCnpj": p.documento.as_str(),
136:             "unidade": p.unidade.unwrap_or(0),
137:         })),
138:         "nomeMotorista": criar.motorista,
139:         "placaVeiculo": criar.placa_veiculo,
140:         "dataExpedicao": criar.data_expedicao.map(|dt| dt.and_utc().timestamp_millis()),
141:         "observacoes": criar.observacoes,
142:         "tipoManifesto": criar.tipo_manifesto.as_ref().map(|t| t.codigo()),
143:         "simCodigo": Option::<i32>::None,
144:         "listaManifestoResiduos": criar.residuos.iter().map(residuo_criacao_para_json).collect::<Vec<_>>(),
145:     })
146: }

152:         codigo_gerado: v.get("codigoGerado").and_then(|n| n.as_i64()),

241:         .and_then(|s| s.as_str())
242:         .and_then(|s| chrono::NaiveDate::parse_from_str(s, "%d/%m/%Y").ok())
243:         .unwrap_or_else(|| chrono::Utc::now().date_naive());
244: 
245:     CdfEmitido {
246:         codigo: v.get("cdfCodigo").and_then(|n| n.as_i64()).map(|n| n.to_string()).unwrap_or_default(),
247:         numero: v.get("cdfNumero").and_then(|s| s.as_str()).unwrap_or_default().to_string(),
248:         data_emissao,
249:         status: v.get("status").and_then(|s| s.as_str()).unwrap_or_default().to_string(),
250:     }
251: }

254:     v.get("objetoResposta")
255: }

257: fn tem_erro(v: &Value) -> bool {
258:     v.get("erro").and_then(|b| b.as_bool()).unwrap_or(false)
259: }
```
