261: pub(crate) struct SinirAdapter;
262: 
263: #[async_trait]
264: impl MtrAdapter for SinirAdapter {
265:     fn system(&self) -> System {
266:         System::Sinir
267:     }
268: 
269:     fn nome(&self) -> &'static str {
270:         "SINIR Nacional"
271:     }
272: 
273:     async fn autenticar_token(&self, ctx: &MtrCtx) -> Result<String, OpenMTRError> {
274:         let span = info_span!("sinir.autenticar_token");
275:         let _guard = span.enter();
276:         let refresh_url = format!("{}/token", ctx.config.base_url);
277:         drop(_guard);
278:         ctx.http.set_refresh_url(&refresh_url).await;
279:         let token = ctx.http.get_token().await?;
280:         info!("Token SINIR renovado com sucesso");
281:         Ok(token)
282:     }
283: 
284:     async fn autenticar_credenciais(
285:         &self,
286:         _ctx: &MtrCtx,
287:         _cpf: &str,
288:         _senha: &str,
289:         _unidade: u32,
290:     ) -> Result<String, OpenMTRError> {
291:         Err(OpenMTRError::not_supported(
292:             "SINIR usa integration_token, não CPF/senha",
293:         ))
294:     }
295: 
296:     async fn consultar_mtrs(
297:         &self,
298:         ctx: &MtrCtx,
299:         filtro: &FiltroMtr,
300:     ) -> Result<LoteResult<Mtr>, OpenMTRError> {
301:         let _span = info_span!("sinir.consultar_mtrs");
302: 
303:         let body = filtro_para_json(filtro);
304:         let response: Value = ctx.http.post("/listaManifesto", &body, "consultar_mtrs").await?;
305: 
306:         if tem_erro(&response) {
307:             warn!(
308:                 mensagem = ?response.get("mensagem"),
309:                 "SINIR retornou erro em consultar_mtrs"
310:             );
311:             return Ok(LoteResult::from_vec(Vec::new()));
312:         }
313: 
314:         let items = response.get("objetoResposta").and_then(|a| a.as_array()).cloned().unwrap_or_default();
315:         let mtrs: Vec<Mtr> = items.iter().map(json_para_mtr).collect();
316: 
317:         info!(total = %mtrs.len(), "MTRs consultados");
318:         Ok(LoteResult::from_vec(mtrs))
319:     }
320: 
321:     async fn criar_mtrs(
322:         &self,
323:         ctx: &MtrCtx,
324:         mtrs: Vec<CriarMtr>,
325:     ) -> Result<LoteResult<MtrCriado>, OpenMTRError> {
326:         let _span = info_span!("sinir.criar_mtrs");
327: 
328:         let mut itens = Vec::with_capacity(mtrs.len());
329: 
330:         for (indice, criar) in mtrs.into_iter().enumerate() {
331:             let body = criar_mtr_para_json(&criar);
332:             match ctx
333:                 .http
334:                 .post::<Value, _>("/salvarManifestoLote", &body, "criar_mtr")
335:                 .await
336:             {
337:                 Ok(resp) => {
338:                     let erro_nacional = resp.get("erroNacional").and_then(|b| b.as_bool()).unwrap_or(false);
339:                     if erro_nacional {
340:                         let msg = resp
341:                             .get("mensagemErroNacional")
342:                             .and_then(|s| s.as_str())
343:                             .unwrap_or("Erro nacional na criação");
344:                         itens.push(ItemResult::Erro {
345:                             indice,
346:                             problema: Problema::validation(msg),
347:                         });
348:                         continue;
349:                     }
350: 
351:                     let some_respostas = resp.get("respostaApiwsManifestoDTO")
352:                         .and_then(|a| a.as_array())
353:                         .cloned()
354:                         .unwrap_or_default();
355: 
356:                     if some_respostas.is_empty() {
357:                         itens.push(ItemResult::Erro {
358:                             indice,
359:                             problema: Problema::validation(
360:                                 "Nenhuma resposta retornada pela API",
361:                             ),
362:                         });
363:                         continue;
364:                     }
365: 
366:                     for r in &some_respostas {
367:                         let criado = json_para_mtr_criado(r);
368:                         if criado.sucesso {
369:                             itens.push(ItemResult::Ok(criado));
370:                         } else {
371:                             itens.push(ItemResult::Erro {
372:                                 indice,
373:                                 problema: Problema::validation(criado.mensagem),
374:                             });
375:                         }
376:                     }
377:                 }
378:                 Err(e) => {
379:                     warn!(erro = %e, "Falha ao criar MTR");
380:                     itens.push(ItemResult::Erro {
381:                         indice,
382:                         problema: Problema::api(502, e.to_string()),
383:                     });
384:                 }
385:             }
386:         }
387: 
388:         info!(total = %itens.len(), "MTRs criados");
389:         Ok(LoteResult::new(itens))
390:     }
391: 
392:     async fn receber_mtrs(
393:         &self,
394:         ctx: &MtrCtx,
395:         lotes: Vec<ReceberMtr>,
396:     ) -> Result<LoteResult<MtrRecebido>, OpenMTRError> {
397:         let _span = info_span!("sinir.receber_mtrs");
398: 
399:         let mut itens = Vec::with_capacity(lotes.len());
400: 
401:         for (indice, receber) in lotes.into_iter().enumerate() {
402:             let body = receber_mtr_para_json(&receber);
403:             match ctx
404:                 .http
405:                 .post::<Value, _>("/receberManifestoLote", &body, "receber_mtr")
406:                 .await
407:             {
408:                 Ok(resp) => {
409:                     let some_items = resp.get("objeto")
410:                         .and_then(|a| a.as_array())
411:                         .cloned()
412:                         .unwrap_or_default();
413: 
414:                     if some_items.is_empty() {
415:                         itens.push(ItemResult::Erro {
416:                             indice,
417:                             problema: Problema::validation("Nenhum retorno no recebimento"),
418:                         });
419:                         continue;
420:                     }
421: 
422:                     for item in &some_items {
423:                         let recebido = json_para_mtr_recebido(item);
424:                         if recebido.recebido {
425:                             itens.push(ItemResult::Ok(recebido));
426:                         } else {
427:                             itens.push(ItemResult::Erro {
428:                                 indice,
429:                                 problema: Problema::validation(
430:                                     recebido.mensagem.unwrap_or_default(),
431:                                 ),
432:                             });
433:                         }
434:                     }
435:                 }
436:                 Err(e) => {
437:                     warn!(erro = %e, "Falha ao receber MTR");
438:                     itens.push(ItemResult::Erro {
439:                         indice,
440:                         problema: Problema::api(502, e.to_string()),
441:                     });
442:                 }
443:             }
444:         }
445: 
446:         info!(total = %itens.len(), "MTRs recebidos");
447:         Ok(LoteResult::new(itens))
448:     }
449: 
450:     async fn cancelar_mtrs(
451:         &self,
452:         ctx: &MtrCtx,
453:         reqs: Vec<CancelarMtr>,
454:     ) -> Result<LoteResult<MtrCancelado>, OpenMTRError> {
455:         let _span = info_span!("sinir.cancelar_mtrs");
456: 
457:         let mut itens = Vec::with_capacity(reqs.len());
458: 
459:         for (indice, req) in reqs.into_iter().enumerate() {
460:             let body = json!({ "manNumero": req.numero, "justificativa": req.justificativa });
461:             match ctx
462:                 .http
463:                 .post::<Value, _>("/cancelarManifesto", &body, "cancelar_mtr")
464:                 .await
465:             {
466:                 Ok(resp) => {
467:                     if tem_erro(&resp) {
468:                         let msg = resp.get("mensagem")
469:                             .and_then(|s| s.as_str())
470:                             .unwrap_or("Erro no cancelamento");
471:                         itens.push(ItemResult::Erro {
472:                             indice,
473:                             problema: Problema::validation(msg),
474:                         });
475:                         continue;
476:                     }
477: 
478:                     match extrair_objeto_resposta(&resp) {
479:                         Some(cancel) => {
480:                             let status_str = cancel.get("status")
481:                                 .and_then(|s| s.as_str())
482:                                 .unwrap_or_default()
483:                                 .to_lowercase();
484:                             if status_str == "cancelado" {
485:                                 itens.push(ItemResult::Ok(MtrCancelado {
486:                                     numero: cancel.get("manNumero")
487:                                         .and_then(|s| s.as_str())
488:                                         .unwrap_or_default()
489:                                         .to_string(),
490:                                     status: cancel.get("status")
491:                                         .and_then(|s| s.as_str())
492:                                         .unwrap_or_default()
493:                                         .to_string(),
494:                                     data_cancelamento: cancel.get("dataCancelamento")
495:                                         .and_then(|s| s.as_str())
496:                                         .map(String::from),
497:                                 }));
498:                             } else {
499:                                 let stat = cancel.get("status")
500:                                     .and_then(|s| s.as_str())
501:                                     .unwrap_or("unknown");
502:                                 itens.push(ItemResult::Erro {
503:                                     indice,
504:                                     problema: Problema::api(
505:                                         400,
506:                                         format!("Status inesperado: {stat}"),
507:                                     ),
508:                                 });
509:                             }
510:                         }
511:                         None => {
512:                             itens.push(ItemResult::Erro {
513:                                 indice,
514:                                 problema: Problema::validation("Resposta vazia no cancelamento"),
515:                             });
516:                         }
517:                     }
518:                 }
519:                 Err(e) => {
520:                     warn!(erro = %e, "Falha ao cancelar MTR");
521:                     itens.push(ItemResult::Erro {
522:                         indice,
523:                         problema: Problema::api(502, e.to_string()),
524:                     });
525:                 }
526:             }
527:         }
528: 
529:         info!(total = %itens.len(), "MTRs cancelados");
530:         Ok(LoteResult::new(itens))
531:     }
532: 
533:     async fn modificar_mtrs(
534:         &self,
535:         ctx: &MtrCtx,
536:         reqs: Vec<ModificarMtr>,
537:     ) -> Result<LoteResult<MtrModificado>, OpenMTRError> {
538:         let _span = info_span!("sinir.modificar_mtrs");
539: 
540:         let mut itens = Vec::with_capacity(reqs.len());
541: 
542:         for (indice, req) in reqs.into_iter().enumerate() {
543:             match req.tipo {
544:                 ModificacaoTipo::Recebimento => {
545:                     let justificativa =
546:                         req.justificativa.unwrap_or_else(|| "Alteração de recebimento".into());
547:                     let novos = req.novos_residuos.unwrap_or_default();
548: 
549:                     let body = json!({
550:                         "manNumero": req.numero,
551:                         "justificativa": justificativa,
552:                         "listaResiduosAlterados": novos.iter().map(|r| json!({
553:                             "resCodigoIbama": r.codigo_ibama,
554:                             "novaQuantidade": r.quantidade_recebida,
555:                             "uniCodigo": r.unidade,
556:                             "observacoes": Option::<String>::None,
557:                         })).collect::<Vec<_>>(),
558:                     });
559: 
560:                     match ctx
561:                         .http
562:                         .post::<Value, _>("/alteraRecebimento", &body, "modificar_mtr")
563:                         .await
564:                     {
565:                         Ok(_json) => {
566:                             itens.push(ItemResult::Ok(MtrModificado {
567:                                 numero: req.numero,
568:                                 modificado: true,
569:                                 mensagem: "Solicitação de alteração enviada".into(),
570:                             }));
571:                         }
572:                         Err(e) => {
573:                             warn!(erro = %e, "Falha ao modificar MTR");
574:                             itens.push(ItemResult::Erro {
575:                                 indice,
576:                                 problema: Problema::api(502, e.to_string()),
577:                             });
578:                         }
579:                     }
580:                 }
581:                 _ => {
582:                     itens.push(ItemResult::Erro {
583:                         indice,
584:                         problema: Problema::validation(format!(
585:                             "Tipo de modificação não suportado no SINIR: {:?}",
586:                             req.tipo
587:                         )),
588:                     });
589:                 }
590:             }
591:         }
592: 
593:         info!(total = %itens.len(), "MTRs modificados");
594:         Ok(LoteResult::new(itens))
595:     }
596: 
597:     async fn download_mtrs(
598:         &self,
599:         ctx: &MtrCtx,
600:         nums: Vec<String>,
601:     ) -> Result<LoteResult<DownloadItem>, OpenMTRError> {
602:         let _span = info_span!("sinir.download_mtrs");
603: 
604:         let mut items = Vec::with_capacity(nums.len());
605: 
606:         for (indice, numero) in nums.into_iter().enumerate() {
607:             let path = format!("/downloadManifesto/{numero}");
608:             match ctx.http.post_bytes(&path, "download_mtr").await {
609:                 Ok(buffer) => {
610:                     items.push(ItemResult::Ok(DownloadItem {
611:                         filename: format!("{numero}.pdf"),
612:                         buffer,
613:                         formato: "pdf".into(),
614:                     }));
615:                 }
616:                 Err(e) => {
617:                     warn!(numero = %numero, erro = %e, "Falha ao baixar MTR");
618:                     items.push(ItemResult::Erro {

643:                     .map(|dt| dt.and_utc().timestamp_millis())

706:             );

709:                 Ok(buffer) => {

711:                         filename: format!("{}.{}", req.codigo, formato_str),
712:                         buffer,

338:             .map(|t| t.to_string())

342: fn map_http_error(status: StatusCode, detail: &str) -> OpenMTRError {
343:     match status.as_u16() {
344:         401 => OpenMTRError::auth(format!("Unauthorized: {detail}")),
345:         403 => OpenMTRError::new(403, "Forbidden", detail),
346:         404 => OpenMTRError::new(404, "Not Found", detail),
347:         422 => OpenMTRError::validation(detail),
348:         429 => OpenMTRError::new(429, "Too Many Requests", detail),
349:         s if s >= 500 => OpenMTRError::new(s, "Server Error", detail),
350:         _ => OpenMTRError::new(status.as_u16(), "HTTP Error", detail),
351:     }
352: }

### 7b. `Periodo` serializes as `dataInicial`/`dataFinal`

The `Periodo` struct (in `mtr.rs`) has a **custom `Serialize` impl** that correctly writes:
```json

```

**Verdict: Correct.**

### 7c. INCONSISTENCY: `FiltroCdf.periodo` uses `Range<NaiveDate>` instead of `Periodo`

**File:** `/projects/my/open-mtr-rs/core/src/openmtr/domain/cdf.rs` (line 37)

```rust
pub periodo: Option<std::ops::Range<NaiveDate>>,
```

Meanwhile `FiltroMtr.periodo` (in `mtr.rs`) correctly uses:
```rust
pub periodo: Option<Periodo>,
```

`FiltroCdf` uses `Range<NaiveDate>`, which will serialize as `{"start": "...", "end": "..."}` instead of the expected `{"dataInicial": "...", "dataFinal": "..."}` format used everywhere else. This is **inconsistent** with `FiltroMtr` and with the overall API contract.

**Severity: Medium.** If `FiltroCdf` is ever serialized for transmission (e.g., to an API), the date range format will be wrong. Currently `SinirAdapter::consultar_cdfs` is a stub, so this is latent.
